pr_title: Add EVP RSA key encode/decode demo
pr_body:
Fixes #14116.

This example uses AES-128-CBC as the demonstration encryption algorithm. Interestingly, encoding doesn't error if AES-128-GCM is specified, but attempting to decode the result fails.
pr_comments: Still good.  Ping @openssl/committers for second review.
This pull request is ready to merge
Merged to both branches after fixing the conflict in the README for 3.0.

issue_context.title: Add an EVP demo for key encoding using RSA
issue_context.body:
Do both encode and decode.

It should be the current best practice (fetch), have proper error handling and resource allocation/deallocation and be in the style of a known answer test.
comments: I'd like to take a crack at this one, if you'd like to assign it to me!
There is likely going to be a new easier API for key generation soon: #14695  The exact form isn't known, however this will only have a minor or no impact on this example.
Yeah, the demo should demonstrate the "normal, full-featured way" not the quick call (that call should not need a demo).

Before I countinue development, I want to make sure I'm on the right track (I'm fairly new to OpenSSL). Could you point out the "core" function(s) that need to be demonstrated? Just want to make sure I get exactly what you want :)
Please look at the examples in https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/master/doc/man3/OSSL_DECODER_from_bio.pod and https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/master/doc/man3/OSSL_ENCODER_to_bio.pod.
Thanks! I'll change what I had coded 😅
perhaps a simple test is to build against a version of openssl that is configured with `no-deprecated`  right, @t8m ?
Yeah, sure, the demo should build fine against no-deprecated build of openssl.

review_comments:
I'm wondering if `EVP_PKEY_PRIVATE_KEY` warrants a mention here?
It's not useful for RSA but for other key types it can be.

I'm fine either way, this is just a thought.
